description: This file implements a logging utility in C, including functions for opening, closing, setting log levels, and logging messages with timestamps and process IDs.

methods.name: open_log
methods.description: Initializes and opens a log file, setting up the log context.

methods.name: close_log
methods.description: Closes the log file and frees associated resources.

methods.name: set_log_level
methods.description: Sets the logging level for the logger.

methods.name: LOG
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified level, module, and formatted message.
